WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.PID, TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) as film_year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
actor_ranges AS (
    SELECT PID, MIN(film_year) as first_year, MAX(film_year) as last_year
    FROM actor_years
    GROUP BY PID
),
all_years AS (
    SELECT ar.PID, ar.first_year, ar.last_year, gen.year as career_year
    FROM actor_ranges ar
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(ar.first_year, ar.last_year)) as gen(year)
),
actor_has_film AS (
    SELECT ay.PID, ay.career_year,
           CASE WHEN ay2.film_year IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_film
    FROM all_years ay
    LEFT JOIN actor_years ay2 ON ay.PID = ay2.PID AND ay.career_year = ay2.film_year
),
-- Mark gaps: for each year, check if it's part of a gap of 4+ consecutive non-film years
actor_gaps AS (
    SELECT PID, career_year, has_film,
           -- A gap year is one where this year and the next 3 years all have no film
           -- We need to check windows of 4 consecutive years
           SUM(has_film) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY career_year ROWS BETWEEN 0 AND 3) as films_in_4_year_window
    FROM actor_has_film
)
SELECT PID, career_year, has_film, films_in_4_year_window
FROM actor_gaps
WHERE PID = 'nm0000096'
ORDER BY career_year"}

{"preview_rows": 50, "sql": "-- Complete analysis: find actors whose career has no gap of 4+ consecutive years
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.PID, TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) as film_year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
actor_ranges AS (
    SELECT PID, MIN(film_year) as first_year, MAX(film_year) as last_year
    FROM actor_years
    GROUP BY PID
),
all_years AS (
    SELECT ar.PID, ar.first_year, ar.last_year, gen.year as career_year
    FROM actor_ranges ar
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(ar.first_year, ar.last_year)) as gen(year)
),
actor_has_film AS (
    SELECT ay.PID, ay.career_year,
           CASE WHEN ay2.film_year IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_film
    FROM all_years ay
    LEFT JOIN actor_years ay2 ON ay.PID = ay2.PID AND ay.career_year = ay2.film_year
),
-- Check each 4-year window: sum of has_film over next 4 years starting from each year
window_check AS (
    SELECT ahf.PID, ahf.career_year, ahf.has_film,
        SUM(ahf2.has_film) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ahf.PID 
            ORDER BY ahf.career_year 
            ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 3 FOLLOWING
        ) as films_in_window
    FROM actor_has_film ahf
)
SELECT PID, career_year, has_film, films_in_window
FROM window_check
WHERE PID = 'nm0000096'
ORDER BY career_year"}
